chunks: And from the hadith of Yazeed bin Sinan, who said: Al-Hasan bin Umar bin Shaqiq narrated to us, saying: Jareer bin Abdul-Hameed narrated to us, from Hussayn bin Abdurrahman, from Jabir bin Samra, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saying: 'After me, twelve emirs will arise among my umma.'
Then he spoke something that I did not hear. He said: So I asked the people and I asked my father, who was closer to the Prophet than I was. He said: The Prophet said: 'All of them are from Quraysh.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the number and lineage of leaders after him?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by al-Nu'mani in *Kitab al-Ghayba*, serves as a foundational proof for the number twelve in Shia eschatology, explicitly linking the twelve Imams to the Quraysh tribe as foretold by the Prophet. The detail of the whispered phrase highlights the oral transmission dynamics in early Islamic scholarship, where proximity to the speaker determined the clarity of the message. It establishes a direct continuity of leadership from the Prophet to the Twelve Imams, reinforcing their legitimacy within the broader Islamic community.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (21) Yazeed bin Sinan narrated from al-Hasan bin Umar bin Shaqeeq from Jareer bin Abdul-Hameed from Hussayn bin Abdurrahman that Jabir Bin Samra had said: I heard the Prophet (S) saying: “After me, there will be twelve emirs ruling my umma.”

Then he said something that I could not hear. I asked some people and asked my father, who was nearer to the Prophet (S) than me. My father said that the Prophet (S) had said: “All of them are from Quraysh.”
